lines.text: David prepared a place and pitched a tent for the ark, then assembled all Israel in Jerusalem.
David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar and the Levite chiefs, saying the Levites were absent the first time.
The Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with poles, as Joshua had commanded.
David and the elders went to bring the ark from the house of Obed-edom, and they sacrificed seven bulls and seven goats.
As the ark entered the City of David, Saul's daughter Michal looked down from a window and saw David dancing.
